standard_prerequisites.name: Compatibility of the cycle class map with pushforwards along a closed immersion

standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the class of the point to the cohomology of the scheme.

core_obligations: Compute on a point (proof lines 3508-3525): for a closed point with separable residue field, viewed as a scheme with inclusion into the scheme, the degree of the cycle class of the point is computed by pushing the class forward along the inclusion, which by compatibility with pushforwards and by the definition of the pushforward on cohomology reduces to the degree map of the point, which is the degree of the residue field extension.
Conclude (proof lines 3525-3535): since the group of zero cycles is generated by classes of such points, the commutativity of the diagram follows for all zero cycles.
proof_roadmap: Verify the commutativity on a closed point with separable residue field.
Use generation of the group of zero cycles to conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the cycle class map and the degree map intertwine the classical degree of zero cycles with the cohomological degree (statement lines 3504-3515). The proof (proof lines 3516-3535) verifies the claim on a closed point with separable residue field using compatibility of the cycle class with pushforwards and the computation for zero dimensional schemes, and concludes by generation of the group of zero cycles. H2: a complete short argument.
